case.summary: This card-not-present fraud investigation was triggered because the transaction amount of $292.36 exceeded the customer's 95th percentile of $91.41. It was assumed that the customer would provide no reply within 24 hours, leaving customer validation missing and the evidence conflicting with an uncertain verdict and 0.4 fraud probability. Because there was no reply within 24 hours, Fraud Policy R4 directs the analyst to recommend monitoring the card and declining pending authorizations, while Fraud Policy 3a keeps the case open as an internal record since the fraud probability reached 0.30.
